summary: This module sets up icon data for the Iconify library at startup, then exports a React component that renders icons. By pre-loading the icon collections before any component renders, we avoid a common problem where the server and browser would show different content during page load.

explanations.10: Object.values() extracts all the icon collections from the object, then forEach() registers each one with Iconify's addCollection function so the icons are ready to use immediately.
explanations.23: This destructures the aria-label prop but renames it to ariaLabel (without the dash) because JavaScript variable names can't have hyphens.
explanations.28: The 'ssr' prop tells the Iconify component to render the SVG directly on the server instead of waiting to fetch it, preventing the mismatch between server and browser output.
